messages.El CSV contiene las cuatro variables, un: The CSV contains all four variables, units, original values, processing flags and the source of each record. Missing values are not filled and forecasts are not included.

messages.El aire se aproxima con medianas por est: Air is approximated using station medians by hour and day type from January–March 2025. We use up to three stations within 5 km, with at least eight observations per profile and two stations per point. Weights follow inverse squared distance.
messages.El aire y las partículas en suspensión e: Air and suspended particles enter through this duct and travel toward the measurement area.
messages.El año y el mes se filtran por fecha del: Year and month filters use the report date. Hour 24 is displayed as 00:00 on the following day, in Bogotá time.
messages.El color muestra el agregado de medicion: Color shows the aggregate of available measurements in each three-hour block. Empty cells do not represent zeros.
messages.El color muestra el promedio temporal es: Color shows the estimated temporal average at the center of each sector. Each variable’s color scale stays consistent across years. Boundaries are preserved; areas without a value appear in gray.
The lead time must be 24, 48 or 72 hours.

messages.El tratamiento interpola primero los hue: Processing first interpolates short gaps, then uses KNN without the day of the week for the remaining gaps. Long fills include smooth synthetic variation by sector, using a fixed seed and an amplitude of 10% of the observed P5–P95 range. This is an exploratory processing choice, not calibrated uncertainty. Original observations are preserved.

messages.Esta iniciativa nació al montar biciclet: This initiative began with bicycle rides through Bogotá and breathing traffic fumes. That experience inspired the idea of comparing routes with the air we breathe and the time we spend riding in mind.
messages.Estación, PM2.5, PM10, temperatura y hum: Station, PM2.5, PM10, temperature and humidity available at the forecast origin; previous pollutant readings from 1 and 24 hours earlier; and calendar features.
messages.Este proyecto surgió al recorrer Bogotá: This project began with bicycle rides through Bogotá and breathing traffic fumes. Routes turns that concern into an everyday question: how can I reach my destination and understand the air along the way?
messages.Estos datos procesados no solo permiten: These processed data can help identify areas with air quality problems and inform more effective mitigation measures and public policies aimed at improving public health and reducing environmental impacts.

messages.Humedad y temperatura se analizan como h: Humidity and temperature are analyzed as historical observations; their forecast models have not been trained yet.
messages.IDW combina las cuatro estaciones dispon: IDW combines the four nearest available stations at each sector’s centroid. These are spatial estimates, not neighborhood measurements or averages over the entire area. Areas more than 10 km from a station require particular caution.
messages.Ilustración animada de una ruta en bicic: Animated illustration of a bicycle route
messages.Integramos la concentración con los minu: We integrate concentration over each segment's minutes, advancing the clock as the bicycle travels. Exposure is compared only when every alternative has complete coverage. The balanced option gives equal relative weight to time and exposure.
messages.La búsqueda consulta Photon; el cálculo: Place searches use Photon; route calculation sends both points to BRouter.
messages.La caja resume cuartiles y mediana del e: The box summarizes error quartiles and the median; points show distant values. It is not a prediction interval.
messages.La diferencia usa únicamente horas prese: The difference uses only hours with readings at both stations.
messages.La electrónica convierte la señal óptica: The electronics convert the optical signal into estimated particle concentrations, expressed in µg/m³.

messages.La hora cambia el perfil histórico del a: The departure time changes the historical air profile. This does not represent live pollution or traffic.
messages.La materia particulada o PM (por sus sig: PM2.5 consists of very small airborne particles with a diameter of 2.5 micrometers (about one ten-thousandth of an inch) or less, narrower than a human hair. Particulate matter, one of the U.S. EPA’s six criteria air pollutants, is a mixture that can include organic chemicals, dust, soot and metals. Sources include cars, trucks, factories, wood burning and other activities.
messages.La mayoría de años anteriores a 2025 tie: Most years before 2025 have only one source day. Completing the calendar does not recover lost measurements or validate annual seasonality. This retrospective processing uses earlier and later data; it does not feed the HGB forecasting model. Each sector has a continuous curve in Processed data; hover to identify source dates and filled gaps.
messages.La misma variable y unidad para todas la: The same variable and unit for every selected station.
The question started with a bike ride.
messages.Las consultas recrean pronósticos del pa: Queries recreate past forecasts. The final quality of the published measurements has not been verified here.
messages.Las estaciones no resuelven el humo de c: Stations cannot resolve fumes on individual streets or current changes. Reference positions may differ from historical ones, and published readings have not been verified here. Small differences between routes do not demonstrate a real improvement.
messages.Las gráficas usan el mismo año, mes y mo: The charts use the same year, month and data mode as the map. Averages are calculated over the represented days. Each variable has its own unit and panel.
messages.Las partículas (PM) de tamaño inferior a: Particles smaller than 1 micrometer are called PM1 (sometimes PM1.0). Their extremely small size makes them particularly hazardous. The smaller a particle’s diameter, the greater the damage it can cause. Tiny airborne particles such as PM1 are small enough to penetrate lung tissue and reach the bloodstream. They can then circulate through the body and cause systemic health effects.
messages.Las partículas del aire pueden afectar l: Airborne particles can affect respiratory and cardiovascular health. Observing them helps explain why reducing pollution matters in everyday life.
messages.Lo que no vemos también cuenta. Explora: What we cannot see matters too. Explore particles, temperature and humidity, and find another way to understand Bogotá.

messages.Me interesa convertir datos en herramien: I enjoy turning data into tools that help people understand real problems. I combine software development, data analysis and machine learning. I like preparing data, exploring patterns and building applications that other people can use. Air Quality Bogotá brings those interests together with my curiosity about new technologies and the world around us.
messages.Mediante un sistema de rutas ya definido: Using a predefined route system, PM2.5 sensors are taken along Bogotá’s streets to measure air quality. The information is then processed using tools and methods such as statistical analysis and machine learning algorithms, with the aim of improving predictions for areas with greater environmental impacts.

messages.Son aquellas partículas sólidas o líquid: PM10 consists of solid or liquid particles such as dust, ash, soot, metal particles, cement or pollen dispersed in the atmosphere, with diameters between 2.5 and 10 µm (one micrometer is one thousandth of a millimeter). They mainly contain inorganic compounds such as silicates and aluminates, heavy metals and organic material associated with carbon particles (soot). They are characterized by a basic pH due to uncontrolled combustion of materials.

messages.es el promedio de la distancia entre est: is the average distance between an estimate and a measurement, in µg/m³. Lower is better. An MAE of 6 means an average absolute error of 6 µg/m³ in the evaluated examples; it does not guarantee that margin for each forecast.
